name: Spire of Solitary Enlightenment
description: In ancient times, this was a great and beautiful place, seemingly made to bless the children of humanity. But the arrow of heaven would descend, making mountains out of flat land and burying the ancient capitol beneath the hills.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Seven Senses I
tabs.description:
Bandits from the sea of sand lurk within this Domain.
Use your understanding of the secrets of the elements to defeat them and obtain the precious artifacts stored here.
